'''Res Nels''' was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]]. He was in command of the operation to rescue [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Talnar]] on [[Naalol/Legends|Naalol]].<ref name="Talnar" />
